chars.COUSIN: a young Moroccan woman about 20, long dark wavy hair in a loose high bun, mustard-yellow oversized hoodie, light blue jeans, white sneakers
chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan teenage boy about 17, short curly black hair, red-and-white varsity jacket, black joggers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon style, vertical. Seen from a doorway: COUSIN sits on a traditional Moroccan salon banquette with patterned cushions in a modest apartment in Kenitra, holding her smartphone close, laughing to herself with a hand over her mouth, cheeky secretive expression. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, centered. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon style, vertical. COUSIN walks away toward a small apartment balcony with laundry lines, phone pressed to her ear, whispering, glancing back over her shoulder to check nobody follows. Evening light. Face visible, centered. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon style, vertical. Moroccan apartment kitchen with blue zellige tiles and a teapot: NARRATOR walks in from the left; COUSIN, startled, quickly ends her call and hides the phone behind her back with an awkward nervous smile. Both faces visible, centered. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon style, vertical. NARRATOR stands in a narrow apartment hallway with arms crossed, frowning, suspicious and jealous, eyes narrowed toward a half-open door at the end of the hallway. Face visible, centered. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon style, vertical. NARRATOR peeks secretly from behind a doorframe in the foreground; in the background of the Moroccan salon COUSIN lies on the banquette giggling at her phone screen, unaware. Night, warm lamp light. Both faces visible, subjects in the central area. No text.
